# SYNAPSE-SR (synapse-sr)

> synapse-sr is an open-source Python package (pip install synapse-sr) that super-resolves Sentinel-2 L2A satellite
> imagery from 10 m to 2 m resolution (red, green, blue, near-infrared), with a physics model of the Sentinel-2
> sensor that keeps every output consistent with the measurement, a per-pixel support map separating measured from
> inferred detail, and calibrated uncertainty. Two models: Flash (default, ~1 s per 1.28 km scene on a laptop CPU)
> and Pro (Mamba state-space network, most detail, best on a GPU). GeoTIFF in, GeoTIFF out; CLI and Python API;
> runs on Colab, Kaggle, Windows, macOS, Linux, CPU-only and offline. On the official opensr-test benchmark (178 scenes,
> five datasets) it is best on five of seven measures (version 0.4.1).

Minimal use:

```python
import synapse_sr
r = synapse_sr.super_resolve("sentinel2_l2a.tif")      # model="pro" for Pro
r.save("sentinel2_2m.tif")
```

CLI: `synapse-sr scene.tif scene_2m.tif`, `synapse-sr --fetch LAT,LON --dates START:END out.tif`, `synapse-sr scenes/ out/`.

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/quickstart/): install, get a scene, super-resolve, save
- [Cheat sheet](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/cheatsheet/): every common task on one page
- [Colab and Kaggle](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/guide/notebooks/): notebook setup
- [Choosing a model and a device](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/guide/models/): Flash vs Pro, CPU/GPU/MPS
- [Inputs](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/guide/inputs/): accepted formats, bands, offsets, cloud masks
- [Outputs](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/guide/outputs/): Result attributes and the saved GeoTIFF
- [Support, confidence and consistency](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/guide/support/): trust layers
- [Applications](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/applications/): crops, urban, water, disaster change
- [Examples](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/examples/): end-to-end recipes
- [API reference](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/api/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/troubleshooting/) and [FAQ](https://sharadhnaidu.github.io/synapse-sr/faq/)
